stem: An out-of-state Ambien prescription is presented 31 days after issue and otherwise appears authentic. What is the Massachusetts consequence?

choices.text: Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
Do not use the out-of-state Schedule IV pathway because its 30-day issue window has elapsed.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.

explanation.core_reasoning: An authorized out-of-state practitioner may issue a Schedule III through VI prescription filled in Massachusetts within 30 days of issue; Schedule III through V prescriptions require pharmacist verification. zolpidem (Ambien) is used for short-term treatment of insomnia.
